ZypheroLab

## Summary
ZypheroLab builds premium, conversion-focused websites for international and Romanian SMBs.
Remote-first. Delivery in 3-5 business days. No tracking — privacy-respecting by design.

## Core services
- Conversion website (landing page / multi-page)
- Technical SEO (canonical, hreflang, schema, Core Web Vitals)
- Growth iteration (KPI tracking via GSC, monthly optimization sprints)

## Pricing
- Starter: €300 — complete landing page, baseline SEO, 3-5 day delivery
- Growth: €600 — multi-page site, advanced technical SEO, KPI reporting
- Custom: on request — e-commerce, API integrations, flexible timeline

## Target audience
- Primary: international businesses (worldwide, remote-first)
- Secondary: Romanian SMBs

## Contact
- Email: hello@zypherolab.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/40747821384
- Contact page: https://zypherolab.com/en/contact.html

## Technical stack
- Static HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JS — no build step, no framework (Astro migration planned)
- Hosting: GitHub Pages + Cloudflare CDN (proxy)
- No analytics tracking — Google Search Console only
- Fonts: self-hosted WOFF2 (Inter + Montserrat), font-display: swap
- Forms: Formspree
- i18n: bilingual RO/EN via js/i18n.js + static HTML fallbacks

## Site structure
- https://zypherolab.com/ — Romanian homepage
- https://zypherolab.com/en/ — English homepage (x-default, primary for international)
- https://zypherolab.com/en/web-services.html — Services EN
- https://zypherolab.com/en/web-pricing.html — Pricing EN

- https://zypherolab.com/studii-de-caz.html — Case studies RO
- https://zypherolab.com/contact.html — Contact RO

## SEO signals
- Schema: Organization, WebSite, WebPage, ProfessionalService (hasOfferCatalog), FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, ContactPage
- hreflang: ro + en + x-default → /en/ (international audience priority)
- Sitemap: https://zypherolab.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://zypherolab.com/robots.txt

## Canonical
- https://zypherolab.com/ (apex only, no www)
- GSC property: URL-prefix https://zypherolab.com/
